title: A runnable guide to 35 agent architectures
friendlyTitle: Learn 35 ways to build AI agents with working code
summary: All Agentic Architectures packages 35 agent patterns—including Reflexion, LATS, GraphRAG, MemGPT, Voyager, and browser agents—as a Python library and runnable textbook. The MIT-licensed repository has about 4,500 stars, supports multiple model providers, and includes a 17-task benchmark leaderboard.
friendlySummary: This project explains 35 common AI agent designs and lets you run them. It includes examples, tests, several model providers, and a small benchmark.
whyItMatters: Builders can compare agent patterns in working code instead of relying on diagrams or marketing labels. The notebooks, tests, container setup, and benchmark framework make it useful for choosing a simpler architecture before committing to a large agent stack.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Use it to compare agent designs and learn which one fits your problem. Working examples can help you avoid building a system that is more complicated than you need.
